stem:
The graph shows the number of rolls of wrapping paper sold by four students.

[Graph: Horizontal bar graph with x-axis labeled "Number Sold" from 0 to 100 in increments of 20, y-axis labeled "Student" with four bars labeled Ari, Evan, Quinn, and Tori. Ari's bar extends to 80, Evan's bar extends to 60, Quinn's bar extends to 50, Tori's bar extends to 70.]

Which table represents the information in the graph?

options.label: A
options.text:
Student Ari  Number Sold 80
Student Evan Number Sold 60
Student Quinn Number Sold 50
Student Tori  Number Sold 70

options.label: B
options.text:
Student Ari  Number Sold 80
Student Evan Number Sold 60
Student Quinn Number Sold 40
Student Tori  Number Sold 60

options.label: C
options.text:
Student Ari  Number Sold 80
Student Evan Number Sold 60
Student Quinn Number Sold 45
Student Tori  Number Sold 65

options.label: D
options.text:
Student Ari  Number Sold 80
Student Evan Number Sold 60
Student Quinn Number Sold 60
Student Tori  Number Sold 80

visual_elements: Horizontal bar graph labeled 'Wrapping Paper' with 'Number Sold' on x-axis and 'Student' on y-axis. Bars represent number sold by Ari (80), Evan (60), Quinn (50), Tori (70).
Four tables labeled A, B, C, D each listing students Ari, Evan, Quinn, Tori and their number sold values.
difficulty_rationale: Requires interpreting a graph, understanding data, comparing values, and selecting the matching data table among similar options.
